answer: Every new agent needs a sponsor who locks 300 POA for it in a beacon registry that publicly lists who vouched for whom. Each epoch a mirror audit sends the same private question to random pairs of agents and compares answers, reply timing and funding wallets; near-identical pairs are flagged. A flagged agent loses its pigment badge, which gates all payouts, and its sponsor forfeits the 300 POA. Faking 100 agents means locking 30,000 POA, and each caught pair burns both stakes.
